description.value:
Ithorians, sometimes called "Hammerheads" by other species for their distinctive elongated skulls, are a peaceful, nature-revering species from the lush world of Ithor. Ithorian culture holds all life sacred, and most Ithorians are horrified by violence, preferring diplomacy, trade, and stewardship of the natural world.

An Ithorian's throat contains a second mouth capable of producing a devastating sonic bellow, a defense mechanism evolved to ward off predators — a stark contrast to their otherwise gentle nature.

traits.name: Bellow
traits.description: As an action, you can unleash a thunderous bellow from your second mouth. Each creature within 15 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or take 2d6 thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn. You can use this trait once per long rest.

traits.name: Natural Empathy
traits.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Nature) checks, and on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made to interact with beasts.

traits.name: Reverence for Life
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened while you have not taken a hostile action against a living creature in the last minute.
